agent_assessment: All plan requirements are implemented and verified. Round 1 identified three gaps: (1) S2D integration missing, (2) verification endpoint untested, (3) release_id round-trip untested. All three have been addressed. S2D now passes release_id and channel through DeployConfig, pipeline stage_deploy, and lpbs_client (with stable→default mapping). Verification endpoint has 5 tests (lightweight match/mismatch, deep mode success/failure, missing params). release_id round-trip test covers commit-with-id, fetch-verify, and commit-without-id. Skills updated for both release_id flow and update_policy. All 1294 LPBS tests pass (0 failures). S2D 11/11 tests pass. Both scenarios build cleanly. One flaky test (TestHandleDownloads_Success) occasionally fails in full suite but passes individually — pre-existing, unrelated to this work.

evidence.title: Channel discovery endpoint (update_handlers.go:204-214, route line 366-367)
evidence.description: GET /api/v1/updates/{app_key}/channels returns ChannelInfo array with channel, platform, version, updated_at. Gated by requireUpdateAPIKey. ListChannels service method (download_service.go:631-671) maps 'default' variant_key back to 'stable' channel.

evidence.title: Verification endpoint (update_handlers.go:231-283, route line 368-369)
evidence.description: GET /api/v1/updates/{app_key}/verify accepts channel, platform, expected_version, deep query params. Lightweight: checks manifest version+sha512 match. Deep: adds S3 HEAD and presign check. Gated by requireUpdateAPIKey.

evidence.title: Update policy CRUD (update_handlers.go:302-359, routes lines 372-375)
evidence.description: GET/PUT /api/v1/admin/download-apps/{app_key}/update-policy. PUT validates check_interval_hours >= 1 and update_mode in (optional, recommended, mandatory). UpdateAppPolicy service at download_service.go:674-691.

evidence.title: release_id stored in artifact commit (download_hosting.go:741-840)
evidence.description: CommitArtifactRequest includes ReleaseID field (line 751). CommitArtifact stores release_id in INSERT (line 795) and handles it in ON CONFLICT clause (line 803). Nullable — backward compatible.
